conbody.p: The SMS mobile app features a Network Validator tool using which you can validate your plant’s Wi-Fi network when deploying an SMS device in a new location.

You can also choose to save your network information on the SMS mobile app for future use. For more information about MQTT and other device communication protocols, see AWS IoT Core – Device communication protocols.
